## Subset2

```r
foo[[]]
foo[[,]]
foo[[,,]]
foo[[x,]]
foo[[x,,]]
foo[[,x]]
foo[[,,x]]
foo[[x,,y]]
foo[[,,x,,y,,]]

foo[[x]]
foo[[x, y]]
foo[[1, 2]]
foo[[x=1,,y=3,4]]
```

## Empty Subset2 Joins Its `]]`

Nothing stands between the `[[` and the `]]`, so the join has to happen on the
bump of the `[[` itself.

```r
x[[]]
```

```cst
RRoot {
    bom_token: missing (optional),
    statements: RStatementList [
        RStatement {
            expression: RSubset2 {
                function: RIdentifier {
                    name_token: IDENT@0..1 "x" [] [],
                },
                arguments: RSubset2Arguments {
                    l_brack2_token: L_BRACK2@1..3 "[[" [] [],
                    items: RArgumentList [],
                    r_brack2_token: R_BRACK2@3..5 "]]" [] [],
                },
            },
            semicolon_token: missing (optional),
        },
    ],
    eof_token: EOF@5..6 "" [Newline("\n")] [],
}
```

## Side By Side Arguments Still Join The `]]` [error]

Recovering inside `[[` must leave the `]]` alone. It is a closing delimiter like
any other, so the recovery set names it; without that, recovery swallows both
brackets and strands the `[[` without a terminator.

```r
x[[a b]]
```

```cst

    bom_token: missing (optional),
    statements: RStatementList [
        RStatement {
            expression: RSubset2 {
                function: RIdentifier {
                    name_token: IDENT@0..1 "x" [] [],
                },
                arguments: RSubset2Arguments {
                    l_brack2_token: L_BRACK2@1..3 "[[" [] [],
                    items: RArgumentList [
                        RArgument {
                            name_clause: missing (optional),
                            value: RIdentifier {
                                name_token: IDENT@3..5 "a" [] [Whitespace(" ")],
                            },
                        },
                        missing separator,
                        RArgument {
                            name_clause: missing (optional),
                            value: RBogusExpression {
                                items: [
                                    IDENT@5..6 "b" [] [],
                                ],
                            },
                        },
                    ],
                    r_brack2_token: R_BRACK2@6..8 "]]" [] [],
                },
            },
            semicolon_token: missing (optional),
        },
    ],
    eof_token: EOF@8..9 "" [Newline("\n")] [],
```

## Subset2 Arguments [pending]

```r
fn
fn[[a]]
fn[[a, b]]
fn[[...]]
fn[[a, ..., b]]

fn[[a = 1]]
fn[[a = ]]

fn[[a = 1, b = 2]]
fn[[a = , b = 2]]

fn[[... = 1]]
fn[[... =]]

fn[["arg" = 1]]
fn[["arg" =]]

# Comma tests
fn[[,]]
fn[[,,,]]
fn[[,,a,,b,,]]

# Comment tests
fn[[
  # comment
]]
fn[[,
  # comment
,]]
fn[[
  a, # comment1
  b # comment2
]]
fn[[
  a # comment1
  = # comment2
  1 # comment3
]]

{expr}[[a = 1]]
```
